traceability.evidence:
Story under test: docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md
Key implementation: - src/rules/valid-req-reference.ts implements the "deep validation" behavior described by the story: - Scans code comments for @story, @req, and @implements annotations via processAllComments → handleComment → processCommentLines → handleAnnotationLine. - For @story lines, extractStoryPath(comment) parses the story path from the JSDoc/block comment. - For @req lines, validateReqLine: - Uses extractReqIdFromLine(line) to obtain the requirement ID. - Calls resolveStoryAndRequirements, which: - Uses validateAndResolveStoryPath({ comment, context, storyPath, cwd }) to: - Reject paths containing '..' or absolute paths using path.isAbsolute(), reporting messageId: "invalidPath" with data { storyPath }. - Resolve project-relative paths with path.resolve() and enforce that resolvedStoryPath stays under cwd. - Uses loadAndCacheRequirements({ resolvedStoryPath, reqCache }) to: - Read the story file content with fs.readFileSync(resolvedStoryPath, "utf8"). - Extract all requirement IDs by applying /REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+/g over the entire markdown content and storing them in a Set. - Cache the Set in a Map<string, Set> reqCache, so each story file is parsed only once per ESLint Program (REQ-DEEP-CACHE). - On any fs error, catches the exception and caches an empty Set instead of throwing, keeping linting robust. - Calls checkRequirementExists({ comment, context, reqId, storyPath, reqSet }) which: - If reqSet.has(reqId) is false, reports context.report({ node: comment, messageId: "reqMissing", data: { reqId, storyPath } }). - For @implements lines, validateImplementsLine: - parseImplementsLine(line) expects the format "@implements ..." and returns { storyPath, reqIds }. - Uses the same resolveStoryAndRequirements + checkRequirementExists flow to validate every reqId against the referenced story file’s requirements. - programListener(context) sets up the ESLint Program visitor: - Creates a shared reqCache Map<string, Set> and rawStoryPath state. - On Program, calls processAllComments({ sourceCode, context, cwd: process.cwd(), reqCache, initialStoryPath: rawStoryPath }) to drive validation across all comments in the file. - Rule metadata in src/rules/valid-req-reference.ts: - meta.type: "problem". - meta.docs.description: "Validate that @req annotations reference existing requirements in referenced story files". - meta.messages: - reqMissing: "Requirement '{{reqId}}' not found in '{{storyPath}}'". - invalidPath: "Invalid story path '{{storyPath}}'". - These messages are annotated with @story docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md and @story docs/stories/007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING.story.md and requirements REQ-ERROR-SPECIFIC / REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT / REQ-ERROR-CONSISTENCY, matching the story’s user-experience and error-reporting expectations.
Integration with plugin and configs: - src/index.ts: - RULE_NAMES includes "valid-req-reference" so the rule is dynamically required and exported via the plugin’s rules object. - TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES maps "traceability/valid-req-reference" to "error". - createTraceabilityFlatConfig and configs.recommended/strict include this rule with severity error, ensuring it participates in normal plugin usage. - Tests in tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts validate that recommended and strict presets enable the traceability rules as documented (including deep validation rules).
Tests directly tied to this story: - tests/rules/valid-req-reference.test.ts: - File header: - "Tests for: docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md" - @story docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md and @req REQ-DEEP-PARSE, plus error-reporting REQs from 007.0. - Valid cases: 1) "[REQ-DEEP-PARSE] valid requirement reference existing in story file": - Code: // @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md // @req REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE - docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md contains the requirement ID: - "- **REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE**: ESLint plugin follows standard Node.js module structure" (verified by search). - Confirms deep validation successfully finds REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE in a real story file with bolded bullet formatting. 2) "[REQ-DEEP-BULLET] valid bullet list requirement existing in bullet story fixture": - Code: // @story tests/fixtures/story_bullet.md // @req REQ-BULLET-LIST - tests/fixtures/story_bullet.md: - "- REQ-BULLET-LIST - a requirement in bullet list format". - Confirms bullet-list requirement format is correctly parsed and validated. 3) "[REQ-DEEP-IMPLEMENTS] single implements line with multiple requirements in multi-story fixture": - Code: // @implements tests/fixtures/story_multi_a.md REQ-SHARED-ID REQ-ONLY-A - tests/fixtures/story_multi_a.md: - "- REQ-SHARED-ID" - "- REQ-ONLY-A". - Demonstrates that @implements with multiple IDs is validated against the story content. 4) "[REQ-DEEP-IMPLEMENTS] multi-story implements with shared requirement IDs": - Code: // @implements tests/fixtures/story_multi_a.md REQ-SHARED-ID REQ-ONLY-A // @implements tests/fixtures/story_multi_b.md REQ-SHARED-ID REQ-ONLY-B - tests/fixtures/story_multi_b.md: - "- REQ-SHARED-ID" - "- REQ-ONLY-B". - Confirms that requirement IDs are scoped per story file and can be reused across files without error (REQ-DEEP-FORMAT / cross-structure support). - Invalid cases: 1) "[REQ-DEEP-MATCH] missing requirement in story file": - Code: // @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md // @req REQ-NON-EXISTENT - Expects: errors: [{ messageId: "reqMissing", data: { reqId: "REQ-NON-EXISTENT", storyPath: "docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md" } }]. - Validates core behavior: missing requirement IDs generate clear, contextual diagnostics. 2) "[REQ-DEEP-PARSE] disallow path traversal in story path": - Code uses @story ../docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md. - Expects messageId: "invalidPath" with the exact storyPath string, validating path security checks. 3) "[REQ-DEEP-PARSE] disallow absolute path in story path": - Code uses an absolute /absolute/path/.... - Expects the same invalidPath message, confirming absolute path protection. 4) "[REQ-DEEP-BULLET] missing bullet list requirement in bullet story fixture": - References REQ-MISSING-BULLET in story_bullet.md. - Expects reqMissing with corresponding reqId and storyPath. 5) "[REQ-DEEP-IMPLEMENTS] missing implements requirement in multi-story fixture": - @implements tests/fixtures/story_multi_a.md REQ-NOT-IN-A. - Expects reqMissing with reqId: REQ-NOT-IN-A, confirming deep validation applies to @implements. 6) "[REQ-DEEP-IMPLEMENTS] disallow path traversal in implements story path": - @implements ../tests/fixtures/story_multi_a.md REQ-SHARED-ID. - Expects invalidPath, confirming path safety for @implements as well.
Documentation for this rule/story: - docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md: - Explicitly annotated with: - @story docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md - @req REQ-DEEP-PARSE, REQ-DEEP-MATCH, REQ-DEEP-PATH. - Describes the behavior: - Deep validation of @req and @implements. - Story file existence and project-boundary constraints. - Parsing story files to extract REQ-IDs and checking each annotation against those IDs. - Error cases for invalidPath (path traversal, absolute paths) and reqMissing (missing requirement IDs). - Explains interaction of @story/@req and @implements and that IDs are scoped per story file. - Provides multiple examples of correct and incorrect usage that match the implementation and tests.
Test execution: - The project’s test command is defined in package.json as "test": "jest --ci --bail". - The tests were run with verbose output via: - npm test -- --verbose - Jest output (captured earlier) includes: - PASS tests/rules/valid-req-reference.test.ts - All 10+ test cases for this rule/story passed, confirming behavior matches the specification.
Mapping to acceptance criteria: 1) Core Functionality (checked in story): - Implemented: the rule validates that all @req and @implements requirements resolve to actual requirement IDs present in their story files, with explicit positive and negative tests. 2) Quality Standards (various formats/structures): - Implemented: the regex-based parser over the full markdown file supports IDs in bold bullets, plain bullets, multi-story fixtures, and more; tests cover different story structures. The strategy matches the story’s requirement identification strategies (explicit REQ lines, bullets, different sections). 3) Integration (with file validation & annotation parsing): - Implemented: rule plugs into the existing comment-based annotation model, uses ESLint RuleContext and Program visitor, and is wired into plugin exports and flat configs alongside the other traceability rules. 4) User Experience (clear error messages): - Implemented: reqMissing and invalidPath messages are concise, contextual, and asserted via tests including their data payload (reqId, storyPath). 5) Error Handling (malformed story files, parsing errors): - Implemented: fs read errors are caught and converted into empty sets, preventing crashes; invalid paths are handled gracefully with a clear diagnostic. Arbitrary markdown structures that do not match the REQ pattern simply contain no IDs and result in normal missing-req behavior instead of hard errors. 6) Documentation (behavior and formats): - Implemented: docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md documents the deep validation behavior, supported annotation styles, and several example scenarios consistent with the story.
Given the concrete rule implementation, its tests, plugin integration, and documentation, all acceptance criteria from docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md are satisfied in the actual code, even though some checkboxes in the story document remain unchecked.
traceability.notes: All aspects of the deep requirement validation story (010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION) are implemented: the valid-req-reference rule parses story files to find REQ IDs, caches them, validates @req and @implements annotations against those IDs with robust path and error handling, integrates into the plugin’s configs, and is covered by focused tests and documentation. The story is therefore fully implemented and passes.
